comparison.objective: Refit a bicycle quick-release front wheel so the bicycle is ride-ready; the candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Wheel/axle alignment, seating in dropouts, and quick-release closure, not coaxial screw and jam-nut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Indexed body identifies a correctly refitted ride-ready wheel; complete numeric tolerances are not included.
comparison.reason: Even without numeric rubric details, wheel installation tests a different assembly ability.
